title: Console as before standalone; inside Patches drop the tab group and banners
asked: Keep console the way it was unless running inside patches then remove tab group and let patches control tabs

steps.text: Restore App tabs plugin; hide it when the console runs inside Patches
Banners back on the console page standalone; only Patches' strip shows them inside Patches

result.summary: Standalone console is as before: App tabs bar (Console / Pilot / axHub) restored and plugin banners on its page. Inside Patches the console shows no tab group and no plugin banners; Patches runs the tabs and shows the banners in its strip. The banners-in-console setting is gone.
